name: catalogs
description: Use this skill when the user asks what they already have, or could add, before building: a node package, a trained model, a dataset or a collection of files, a portal to download data from, another agent, a scenario from another project, or where a key for node code is kept, even if they never say catalog. It says what each of Curio's seven catalogs holds, which tool searches or adds from it, and how node code loads a dataset, a model or a key by its id.
